extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media professionals, researchers, donors, and the general public interested in women's representation in media
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational 'About' page describing the Women’s Media Center's mission, publications, programs, and resources aimed at improving women's visibility and representation in media. Includes references to research guides, training programs, expert database (SheSource), press kit materials, and policy statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Raise visibility, viability, and decision-making power of women and girls in media
rubrics_metrics.description: WMC is a progressive, nonpartisan, nonprofit organization working to raise the visibility, viability and decision-making power of women and girls in media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use an array of interconnected channels and platforms to transform the media landscape and culture so women's and girls' voices, stories, experiences and images are amplified and placed on par with those of men and boys.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fair and accurate language
rubrics_metrics.description: Referenced by title: 'Unspinning the Spin: The Women’s Media Center Guide to Fair and Accurate Language.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advocate for and use language that is fair and accurate when covering women and gendered issues (implicit guidance via WMC publication).

rubrics_metrics.name: Gender-neutral coverage of women candidates and politicians
rubrics_metrics.description: Referenced by title: 'The Women’s Media Center Media Guide to Gender Neutral Coverage of Women Candidates + Politicians.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage media coverage that avoids gendered framing and bias when reporting on women candidates and politicians (guide as resource).

rubrics_metrics.name: Accurate and gender-aware coverage of reproductive issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Referenced by title: 'The Women’s Media Center Media Guide to Covering Reproductive Issues' and 'WMC Media Watch: The Gender Gap in Coverage of Reproductive Issues.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlight and correct gender gaps and inaccuracies in how reproductive issues are covered; use WMC reports/guides to inform reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsible reporting on campus rape and sexual assault
rubrics_metrics.description: Referenced by title: 'Writing Rape: How U.S. Media Cover Campus Rape and Sexual Assault.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow best practices and attention to nuance in reporting on sexual violence (as outlined in WMC research) to avoid misrepresentation and harm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor gender representation in awards and nominations
rubrics_metrics.description: WMC publishes investigations such as '2016 Review of Gender & Emmy Primetime Nominations' and analyses of gender & Oscar nominations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track and analyze gender disparities in high-profile awards to hold media/industry accountable; use WMC reports as evidence and guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide women's perspectives on headlines and timely events
rubrics_metrics.description: WMC original content channels provide women’s perspectives on both headline stories and timely events that are ignored, not wholly captured or misrepresented in the mainstream media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure coverage includes women's viewpoints, particularly on stories that mainstream media may misrepresent or omit; use WMC channels as models or sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain racially and globally diverse contributors
rubrics_metrics.description: Our content contributors are a racially and globally diverse group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize diversity of voices and backgrounds in content production to better represent varied women's experiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author commentary represents the author's views, not WMC's
rubrics_metrics.description: The views expressed in commentaries on this site are those of the author alone and do not represent the Women's Media Center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When publishing commentary, attribute opinions to individual authors and distinguish organizational positions from personal viewpoints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nonpartisan status and non-endorsement policy
rubrics_metrics.description: WMC is a 501(c)(3) organization and does not endorse candidates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain nonprofit legal compliance and refrain from candidate endorsements in public communications and programming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media training and leadership to sharpen media savvy and interview skills
rubrics_metrics.description: Our WMC training and leadership programs sharpen the media savvy and interview skills of women and girls.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer and use training programs to prepare women for media appearances and public-facing roles to improve representation and effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: SheSource: ethnically diverse expert database for journalists and bookers
rubrics_metrics.description: WMC SheSource, our ethnically diverse online brain trust of more than 1,900 female experts on a wide array of topics, helps journalists, talent bookers and other content producers to get their jobs done.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use and contribute to SheSource to locate qualified female experts across topics; emphasizes ethnic diversity among experts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press kit with approved images, logos, and biographies
rubrics_metrics.description: The Women’s Media Center press kit contains approved WMC images, logos and biographies for reporters, editors, producers and bookers, in addition to our press release database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use only approved organizational visual assets and bios when reporting on or booking WMC-related content; consult press kit for official materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organize events to honor and advance women in media
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on our annual Women in Media Awards and other events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Host and publicize events (e.g., awards) as part of strategy to elevate women’s profiles in media; use events to network, recognize achievement, and advance the mission.
